body:
### Summary

Hello uv folks.

In Fedora, we have triaged several already disclosed CVEs from pypa/virtualenv as they were reported to the uv package as well (reasons not important, happy to explain). With LLM (Claude Sonnet 5) I have found that CVE-2026-113723 is reproducible in uv 0.13.6 on Fedora Linux.

https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/commit/5f48d711731311428aebfae61d46957762155b22

uv's bash/zsh activate script never implements any of the backslash/dollar/backtick escaping virtualenv progressively added for its PS1-embedded prompt value; it splices the attacker-controlled --prompt value (or venv directory name) directly into a double-quoted shell assignment, so command substitution in that value runs immediately when the script is sourced, under both bash and zsh.

    uv venv --prompt 'x$(touch /tmp/PWNED)y' venv
    bash -c 'source venv/bin/activate'
    ls /tmp/PWNED   # command ran immediately at source time, not on prompt redraw 

I have reported this to security at astral.sh but this does not constitute vulnerability within uv’s attacker and threat models, hence I am reporting this as a regular bug.

### Platform

Fedora Linux

### Version

0.13.6

### Python version

any
title: Bash prompt values can change meaning under older compatibility modes (POSIX)
